name: BulkTranscripts API
description: YouTube transcripts, search, and channel/playlist listings. Every request needs an API key: create one free at https://bulktranscripts.co/app?tab=mcp (Google sign-in, 30 free credits, no card) and send it as Authorization: Bearer bt_ak_... or X-API-Key. A license key from checkout and an MCP OAuth access token work as Bearer tokens too. A request with no credential returns 401 missing_api_key. A transcript costs 1 credit the first time it enters your library, even if another caller already cached it; repeat reads from your own library are free. Rate limits: 120 requests/min per IP overall, 30/min under /api/v1. Docs: https://bulktranscripts.co/docs
